title: Combining kindness and severity
next_chapter_hook: Demonic Path commander sent a visitation card, its contents only four characters: 'Old friends reunite'

text.content: When the morning bell sounded its seventh toll, the Tianqing Sect Council Hall was already packed with people. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back on the jade steps, his black robe gleaming with cold luster in the morning light. Han Lie's arrogant words from last night still echoed in his ears, yet he merely cast a casual glance across the hall, a knowing smile playing at the corner of his lips. 'You've all come quite promptly.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. 'Today's assembly addresses only three matters—new order, old grievances, and... the situation some have yet to see clearly.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji descended the jade steps slowly, each footstep pressing down on everyone's heartstrings. 'First rule of the new order—' He paused, his gaze sweeping across the terrified old ministers. 'The Observer System officially commences. From this day forward, no one may secretly divine Heavenly Secrets; those who violate...' He raised his hand, and a streak of golden light disappeared into the hall's stone tablet. 'The Heavenly Eye will handle the rest.'

Su Qingyao stood in the side hall, her gaze complicated as she watched that golden light disappear into the stone tablet. She stepped forward, her voice cold and clear: 'May I ask, Observer, what happens if someone questions this system?' Her question seemed provocative, but in truth, she was setting the stage for Chen Ji—this was clearly helping him establish authority.

Chen Ji turned to Su Qingyao, a flicker of appreciation in his eyes. 'Well asked.' He raised his hand, and a screen of light materialized, displaying three choices: challengers could leave the sect, never set foot in the cultivation world again, or... 'Accept the Heavenly Eye's judgment and have all memories of the new order erased.' He smiled, his tone casual. 'Of course, if anyone thinks they're tough enough, they're welcome to try.'

A murmur rippled through the hall. Just then, Ye Qing emerged from the side hall, her jet-black dress complementing her porcelain skin. Leaning close to Chen Ji's ear, her voice barely audible: 'There's activity on the Demonic Path's side—the commander has already broken camp.' Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged; he merely nodded slightly, signaling her to stay calm.

text.content: An elderly minister with silver hair suddenly stepped forward, his voice trembling yet tinged with heroism: 'Chen Ji! This old servant has followed Tianqing Sect for three hundred years, yet never have I witnessed such... such heresy against the heavens! The Observer System is clearly stealing Heavenly Secrets and betraying our ancestors!' His voice echoed through the hall, sparking an uproar.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained unruffled, merely watching the elderly minister with an even deeper smile. 'Three hundred years?' He approached the minister slowly, each step exuding pressure. 'Three hundred years of loyalty, yet you didn't even realize the heavens have changed hands—tell me, elder, were you truly serving Tianqing Sect, or chasing a dream of your own imagination?'

text.content: Before his words even faded, the Heavenly Eye in the hall suddenly blazed with golden light. The old minister let out a tragic cry, his eyes losing focus as he collapsed to the ground like struck by lightning. A moment later, he gazed around in bewilderment, recognizing no one. The Heavenly Eye's voice echoed through the hall: 'Memory erasure complete. Those who defy the new order, take this as warning.'

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye has already demonstrated iron authority—how should we placate the terrified old ministers next?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, continue using forceful methods to subdue dissenters, let everyone understand the consequences of defiance
choices.visible_cost: May deepen old ministers' fear, Reputation -5
choices.visible_reward: Completely suppress dissenting voices, Order Stability +10

text.content: Chen Ji swept a cold gaze across the entire hall: 'Is there anyone else who wants to try?' Utter silence filled the hall; even breathing seemed lighter. Those old ministers who had been itching to act now lowered their heads one after another.

choices.description: Show tolerance, grant old ministers choice and dignity, turn enemies into friends
choices.visible_reward: Old ministers' favor greatly increased, Trust +15
choices.risk_hint: A weak image may affect future prestige

dialogue.content: Chen Ji personally helped the elderly minister to his feet, his gaze softening: 'Elder, you've been startled. Though the Heavenly Eye acted hastily, it was for the sect's hundred-year plan. If any of you have doubts, feel free to seek me privately; Chen will answer each one.' His voice was like spring rain, instantly dispelling the hall's heavy atmosphere.

choices.description: Have Su Qingyao propose establishing an Observer Court, replacing rule of man with rule of law
choices.visible_cost: It takes time to establish institutional authority.
choices.visible_reward: A brand new political system is initiated. Reputation +10, Strategy +5.
choices.risk_hint: During the early stages of system establishment, some may attempt to exploit loopholes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji glanced at Su Qingyao and gave a subtle nod. Understanding his meaning, Su Qingyao stepped forward and declared loudly: 'In that case, why not establish an Observer Court, where multiple people deliberate together to prevent the弊端 of autocratic decision-making?' The moment these words fell, the atmosphere in the hall shifted immediately—this was clearly putting reins on Chen Ji's power, yet it also gave everyone hope.

text.content: Su Qingyao's proposal stirred up waves in the hall. Those originally terrified old ministers had hope rekindling in their eyes—there would be rules with a court, and with rules there would be a way out. Chen Ji watched her, nodding secretly in his heart. This woman always manages to offer the most appropriate piece at critical moments.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao continued: 'The court members shall be jointly recommended by disciples from various factions, and even the Observer must be subject to their supervision. This way, we both preserve the dignity of the new order and maintain harmony within the sect.' She gazed at Chen Ji, her eyes flickering with a meaning only he could decipher: 'I wonder what Fellow Apprentice Chen thinks?'

Chen Ji laughed while applauding: 'Junior Sister Su truly speaks to my heart.' He surveyed the surroundings, his voice clear: 'Everyone has heard it—the matter of the court shall proceed as Junior Sister Su described. However...' His tone shifted, his eyes flashing with a sharp light: 'Before the court is established, the Observer still retains veto power. Those thinking of causing trouble, you'd better reconsider now.'

choice.prompt: The hall's atmosphere slightly eased, when Ye Qing once again signaled there was urgent military intelligence. How should this be handled?

choices.description: Listen to the demonic path military intelligence before everyone, demonstrating trust in allies while making all understand the current situation
choices.visible_cost: The old ministers may become even more panicked
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's trust greatly increases, Reputation +5
choices.risk_hint: The demonic path forces' intervention may trigger chain reactions

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped forward, her voice cold yet loud enough for all to hear: 'The demonic path commander has broken camp, and a hundred thousand-strong army is moving toward the Tianqing Sect. Distance from here... three days.' The hall erupted in chaos, those old ministers who had just been terrified saw their faces turn deathly pale.

choices.description: Signal Ye Qing to report privately later, first stabilize the court and people's hearts
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal battle opportunity
choices.visible_reward: The court is stable, people's hearts are unshaken
choices.risk_hint: If news leaks, it will appear deliberately concealed

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head, signaling Ye Qing to remain calm. He turned to the ministers, his voice still steady: 'Everyone need not panic, these few storms cannot capsize the great ship of the Tianqing Sect.' Saying this, he looked at Su Qingyao: 'The court session continues. Junior Sister Su, please explain the court regulations.'

text.content: No matter which path was chosen, Ye Qing's gaze always fell on Chen Ji. She had seen too many so-called heroes scrambling and speaking carelessly in the face of crisis. But this man before her, even upon hearing a hundred thousand armies pressing at the border, remained composed and calm, as if everything was within his expectations. This feeling gave her both reassurance and a certain... chilling unease.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing lowered her voice, so only Chen Ji could hear: 'The commander has sent an envoy who has already arrived outside the sect gates. He says... he wants to meet an old acquaintance.' Her eyes flickered: 'I always feel the visitor harbors ill intentions.'

text.content: Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed. 'Old acquaintance'? This word reminded him of Han Lie's wild boasts when departing, of that old minister whose memory was erased by Heavenly Eye, of the great game of the world he had been orchestrating for years. 'Interesting.' He murmured: 'It seems after this court session, there's an even bigger spectacle to witness.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao seemed to sense something amiss. She descended the jade steps, approaching Chen Ji's side, and whispered: 'What happened?' Her intuition told her something was slipping beyond control. Chen Ji turned to look at her, the corner of his mouth curving into a smile: 'A small matter. Someone wants to come claiming kinship, and I'm preparing a proper reception.'

choice.prompt: The demonic path envoy is waiting outside the gates. How should this meeting be arranged?

choices.description: Personally leading disciples to welcome, demonstrating the Tianqing Sect's new order of openness and confidence
choices.visible_cost: May be perceived as showing weakness
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars, various forces regard them with newfound respect
choices.risk_hint: If the other party intends to provoke, they may lose composure in public

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his robes and actually walked toward the hall's entrance. This move left everyone stunned——that waste disciple, that servant ridiculed by the entire sect, now welcoming Demonic Path visitors in such a manner? Su Qingyao followed behind, her heart stirring with an indescribable emotion.

choices.description: Let Ye Qing probe first, while observing the visitor's intentions from behind the scenes
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative, free to advance or retreat
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's purpose is pure, may miss a golden opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji gave Ye Qing a subtle glance. Understanding, Ye Qing turned and walked toward the hall's entrance. Chen Ji unhurriedly returned to the jade steps, lifting his teacup for a light sip, as if merely awaiting some insignificant news. Su Qingyao observed this scene, internally marveling: the depth of this man's thoughts is truly unfathomable.

choices.description: Present the highest level of alert, letting the Demonic Path know the Tianqing Sect is not to be provoked
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is more powerful, may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji waved his hand, and golden light instantly blazed outside the hall——that was the state of Tianji Foresight fully activated. He announced loudly: 'Please invite the Demonic Path envoy into the hall.' His voice was not loud, yet it spread in all directions, causing the sect gate to hum. This move was both an invitation and a warning.

Soon, Ye Qing led a black-robed envoy into the main hall. The envoy was shrouded in a faint demonic aura, yet possessed an unexpectedly handsome face. He scanned the hall's occupants, his gaze finally settling on Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curving his lips: 'Chen Tianming... no, I should call you Chen Ji. I've heard your name for a long time, and today I'm finally meeting you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji set down his teacup, his gaze calmly meeting the envoy's eyes: 'The envoy has traveled far; does the commander have any instructions?' His tone was placid, as if asking about today's weather. The envoy remained silent, simply taking an invitation letter from his breast pocket and gently placing it beneath the jade steps: 'The commander says four words——old friends reunite.'

text.content: Old friends reunite. These four words detonated like a thunderclap in Chen Ji's heart. His expression remained unchanged, but his mind churned with massive waves. Who was the Demonic Path commander? Why did they call him an old friend? Could it be... impossible, that person died long ago. While his thoughts churned, the envoy had already turned and departed, leaving only one sentence echoing in the hall: 'In three days, the commander will personally arrive. Then, all truths will be revealed.'

The hall fell into deathly silence once more. Chen Ji slowly rose and approached the invitation letter. There was no signature, only a familiar mark——a totem he had seen in the Chen family ancestral hall during his childhood. His fingers trembled slightly, then steadied. He tucked the letter into his sleeve. Turning to look at Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, his eyes had regained their usual depth: 'It seems we have a tough battle ahead.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward, her voice low: 'That mark... I feel like I've seen it somewhere.' She furrowed her brows,，努力回忆着。 Chen Ji and Ye Qing simultaneously turned to look at her, the former's gaze tinged with tension, the latter's filled with confusion. Chen Ji spoke, his tone unusually gentle: 'Su Junior Sister, would you be willing to tell me where you saw this mark?'
